question.text: Chapter 2 references a loan-guarantee scheme for micro-entrepreneurs innovated between which NPO and which corporate?

answer.text: Teach For India and Wipro Foundation.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.64 of the workbook, 'Pratham, one of India's largest NPOs, has tied up with Godrej Properties Ltd. to innovate a loan-guarantee scheme for micro-entrepreneurs, that is an interesting variation on the grants-in, grants-out structure.' The Trap: Options B, C and D are plausible Indian NPO/corporate pairings but not the example given on pp.63-64. Note: The Pratham–Godrej Properties Ltd. loan-guarantee example is the one specifically cited in the chapter; treat it as a variation on the grants-in/grants-out structure.
